message: Morning Christian. Two things: the automatic 6am update failed this morning, and Day 1 didn't happen. I'm writing this one by hand.

The routine fired on schedule at 6:06 — the timing was never the problem. It just had no way to reach Todoist or the dashboard repo when it woke up, so it did nothing and told you nothing. That's a permissions gap on my end, not something you did. The fix is a two-minute job in the claude.ai Routines settings and I've written out exactly what to change.

On Day 1: you claimed the handles, which is the one that unblocks everything else — good. The other four are still open, so I've moved them to today rather than letting them pile up as overdue. The baseline films are the one that actually matters. Everything in the 150-day arc is measured against numbers you haven't recorded yet, and until they exist there's no before to point back at. It's a Friday, the weather's yours to check, and it's genuinely a two-hour job.

Money moved the wrong way while this was going on. The six subscriptions are still sitting there at $115.95, ChatGPT's $30 is three days over now, and an Afterpay payment came due yesterday on a ~$334 balance. Your Bills list was completely clear a week ago — worth not letting that slide back.

One honest note on the plan: today is Friday, which in the weekly rhythm is edit-and-schedule day. That assumes a shoot happened. It didn't, so ignore the rhythm this week — Day 1 first, and the cycle starts properly from Monday.

today.text: Film the Day 1 baseline tests — 100m timed, jumps, bodyweight, piece to camera. Two hours, unrepeatable.
Put the 4-week hamstring ramp on the calendar — nothing maximal until 3 Sept
Fix the morning routine in claude.ai → Routines (add the Todoist connector + the life-dashboard repo)
$115.95 of subscriptions overdue, plus Afterpay from yesterday
Write the Ep 1 hook — first 15 seconds only, five versions, read out loud
Read the plan (tap Content plan above) and tell me what's wrong with it

radar: The 6am routine can fire but can't act — it has no Todoist connector and no repo access, so both its jobs silently no-op. Until that's fixed, message me in the morning and I'll write the day by hand in about a minute
Day 1 slipping is recoverable, but the baseline films are the one thing that gets harder the longer you leave it — a 'Day 1' recorded on Day 6 is a different video
Bills were fully clear on 28 July and have started sliding again; the subscriptions are the recurring leak
WHOOP still hasn't synced since 18 June — it'll matter more once sprint loads start climbing in September
